mapper.sql: id, title, content_html, send_status, recipient_count, success_count, fail_count, create_by, create_time, update_time, send_time, is_delete

id, title, send_status as sendStatus, case send_status when 0 then '草稿' when 1 then '发送中' when 2 then '已完成' else '' end as sendStatusName, recipient_count as recipientCount, success_count as successCount, fail_count as failCount, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, send_time as sendTime
mapper.select: select from basket_mail_notice where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_mail_notice where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 for update
select , content_html as contentHtml from basket_mail_notice where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_mail_notice where is_delete = 0 and send_status = #{sendStatus} and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by id desc
select id from basket_mail_notice where is_delete = 0 and send_status = 1 order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into basket_mail_notice ( title, content_html, send_status, recipient_count, success_count, fail_count, create_by, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values ( #{title}, #{contentHtml}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{createBy}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.update: update basket_mail_notice set title = #{title}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and send_status = 0
update basket_mail_notice set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and send_status = 0

update basket_mail_notice set send_status = 1, recipient_count = #{recipientCount}, success_count = 0, fail_count = 0, send_time = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and send_status = 0

update basket_mail_notice n set success_count = ( select count(*) from basket_mail_notice_recipient r where r.notice_id = n.id and r.send_status = 1 ), fail_count = ( select count(*) from basket_mail_notice_recipient r where r.notice_id = n.id and r.send_status = 2 ), update_time = now() where n.id = #{id} and n.is_delete = 0

update basket_mail_notice n set send_status = 2, send_time = ifnull(send_time, now()), update_time = now() where n.id = #{id} and n.is_delete = 0 and n.send_status = 1 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_mail_notice_recipient r where r.notice_id = n.id and r.send_status = 0 )
